fusions.name: Spore Puff
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of spore-laden locusts 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave them [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Gut-Rot
fusions.desc: A bite that seeds rot inside one enemy, dealing 30 damage that ignores its resistances and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Husk
fusions.desc: The nearest body sprouts a spore cloud for 8 seconds; every enemy within 4 tiles of it is [Diseased], taking 4 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Colonies Ripen
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a spore stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. At 8 they all burst at once, striking that enemy for 26% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
